programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK Newsline brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Chatroom Japan
programme.desc: How would you reach out to the person next to you in times of disaster? That is the question Amy Takebe asks her students based on her experience in 2011.

programme.title: Impacts: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: The entire Earth is affected by climate change, occurring with a greater speed and scale than ever before. This programme uses scientific data and the latest findings to raise awareness on its impact.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Ehime / Nagazumi Takashi (musician) Nagazumi visits a town with a great number of trowel reliefs, and observes that the things that truly last are the ones that carry the creator's intention.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: The team visits Seki, Japan's 'blade capital' where once they made traditional swords, and now they make household instruments like knives, scissors and, as you'll see, many kinds of nail clippers.

programme.title: AIZU
programme.desc: In Okuaizu, large temperature swings shape vivid seasons and picturesque scenes with trains running through them. Take in the region's rich, majestic nature in time-lapse.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK Newsline brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: The Seasons of Yamato
programme.desc: A series of poetic videos by Koichi Hozan, a videographer living in Nara, in collaboration with a pianist, Mine Kawakami, for which she plays exclusive pieces, makes you experience each seasons.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Explore how Japan uses artificial satellites and surface observation to quickly assess flood and earthquake damage, supporting disaster preparedness.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history and culture. This episode looks at words related to sound. Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: Easy Japanese
programme.desc: #40 Since it was my first earthquake, I was startled. / To explain the reason for your action, say the reason followed by the particle 'kara,' then the action.

programme.title: Culture Crossroads
programme.desc: A popular cafe in Osaka offers international dishes on a day-by-day rotating basis. This helps the foreign residents who prepare them, called 'one-day chefs,' to get involved in Japanese society.

programme.title: Hello! NHK World-Japan
programme.desc: Design x Stories, a regular NHK World-Japan show, will be shown in Japanese from October 2, on NHK E. We introduce the programme, plus others popular in Japan, like 'Ramen Japan' and 'Japan Delish.'

programme.desc: NHK Newsline brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Seasoning the Seasons
programme.desc: This programme visits places across Japan to introduce the charms of their local daily life and festivals fostered by the nation's long history.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK Newsline brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Darwin's Amazing Animals
programme.desc: Cheetah cubs face daunting survival odds on the African savanna. But their mothers go to great lengths to pass on the skills they'll need to fulfil their destiny as the world's fastest land animal.

programme.title: Time-Lapse Journey
programme.desc: Tokachi is in Japan's great northern land of Hokkaido, home to vast fields and sprawling pastures. Experience its vibrant summer colours through time-lapse photography.

programme.title: Grand Sumo Highlights

programme.title: The Southerner
programme.desc: 1945. Drama. Director: Jean Renoir. Stars Zachary Scott, Betty Field and J. Carrol Naish. Nature decides to go against a family of cotton pickers after they decide to get their own ground. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: A Village Wooing. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Alexander Gauge & Bernadette O'Farrell. Robin attempts to help Wat Longfellow, a man who became an outlaw to escape a life of indentured servitude. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Printer's Devil. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Miles Malleson & Noel Coleman. Tempest comes to the aid of a printer who is shut down for spreading the truth about corruption within the government. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: Ice-Fall. 1961. Stars George Murcell, David Graham & Graydon Gould. While the Supercar team are on a picnic in the mountains, Dr. Beaker becomes trapped when investigating a frozen waterfall. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Week-End Guest. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Mary Hinton & Kenneth Haigh. A young reporter is sent by a London newspaper to interview a woman regarding a celebrated author. [S]

programme.title: Vengeance Is Mine
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Director: Alan Cullimore. Stars Valentine Dyall, Anne Firth, Richard Goolden & Sam Kydd. A dying man hires an assassin to kill so he can frame his death on an enemy. [S]

programme.title: Star Performance: A Place Full of Strangers
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Roy Kellino. Stars Dick Powell & Dina Merrill. An overworked businessman tries to escape from his hectic life and goes on a surreal bus trip to 'Meadville'. [S]

programme.title: Impact (1949)
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directed by Arthur Lubin. Stars Brian Donlevy, Ella Raines & Charles Coburn. An unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. [S]

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Transit. 1975. Stars Nicholas Smith, John Collin & Janette Legge. A mystery call out for noise down the docks perplexes Yates, and he's stuck there with DS Haggar and an irritating PC. [S]

programme.title: Port of Escape
programme.desc: 1956. Crime drama directed by Anthony Young. Two men on the run hide out in a Thames boat and take the woman owner hostage. Starring Bill Kerr, Googie Withers and Joan Hickson. [S]

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: A King's Ransom. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Iain Gregory & Trader Faulkner. Leopold demands a high price for Richard's release so the Queen commands Sir Gilbert and Sir Geoffrey to raise the money. [S]

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout October. [S]

programme.title: A Hill in Korea
programme.desc: 1956. War. Directed by Julian Amyes. Stars George Baker, Stanley Baker & Michael Caine in his first credited film role. In the Korean war, British soldiers try to fight their way back to safety. [S]

programme.title: Octavius and Me
